gui.copperpipes.card.no_rules: No rules yet - pick a kind, type a name
gui.copperpipes.legend.title: How it works
gui.copperpipes.legend.1: Item: one exact item, e.g. minecraft:oak_log.
gui.copperpipes.legend.2: Tag: a group of items, e.g. minecraft:logs = every kind of log.
gui.copperpipes.legend.3: Mod: everything from one mod, e.g. minecraft.
gui.copperpipes.legend.4: Add: matching items go to this chest.
gui.copperpipes.legend.5: Exclude (NOT): never these, even if another rule matches.
gui.copperpipes.legend.6: Priority 0-9: higher priority chests are filled first.
gui.copperpipes.legend.7: Blacklist flips the card: everything except its rules.
gui.copperpipes.legend.8: An inlet without a card takes whatever is left (overflow).
gui.copperpipes.legend.9: Click an item into the grey slot to see its tags.
